categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice Recorded After Goods Receipt
categories.description: The purchase order item follows a 3-way matching control regime where the invoice is recorded after the goods receipt. This advances working-capital efficiency while preserving value-matching control integrity, judged against the Time to clearance, 3-way after GR indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=5. Supported by frequent process variants such as V0001, V0002, V0005, and V0010 where goods receipt consistently precedes invoice recording.

categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice Recorded Before Goods Receipt
categories.description: The purchase order item follows a 3-way matching control regime where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt. This helps maximize working-capital efficiency and preserve control integrity, judged against the Time to clearance, 3-way before GR indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=6. Supported by process variants such as V0004, V0007, and V0008 where invoice receipt occurs prior to goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-Way Matched (No Goods Receipt Required)
categories.description: The purchase order item is resolved via a 2-way match where no goods receipt is required. This helps minimize procurement and matching overhead, judged against the Time to clearance, 2-way match indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=7, representing service-based or streamlined items that omit goods receipt and directly record and clear invoices (e.g. V0064).

categories.name: Resolve via Consignment Consumption
categories.description: The purchase order item is resolved via consignment consumption, helping minimize procurement and matching overhead while impacting value-matching control integrity.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=13 as specified in the goal-task decomposition under the OR-decomposed matching regime.
